summary: Mesabi Trust filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 7.01 to report receipt of a quarterly royalty report and payment from Cleveland-Cliffs for iron ore shipments. The trust received $1,625,300 in total royalties, with no bonus royalty due to prices below the 2026 adjusted threshold of $71.70/ton. This is a routine operational and financial disclosure regarding royalty income, not a special situation event. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other corporate actions involved. The filing serves to update shareholders on quarterly results and royalty calculations, with no structural change to the trust or its securities.
